eligibility_reason: The paper reports one in-scope prevalence estimate: the share of study participants who visited at least one untrustworthy website during Wave 2. Other reported percentages concern beliefs, associations, or dosage effects rather than misinformation prevalence.

estimates.measure: share who were exposed to at least one untrustworthy website
estimates.misinfo_definition: Exposure was defined as visiting at least one unique domain from a list of 1,796 domains, including domains classified by NewsGuard as repeatedly publishing false content and domains identified in prior misinformation research.
estimates.source_quote: In our data, 39.6% (95% CI [36.8, 42.4]) of our participants were exposed to at least one untrustworthy website in Wave 2.
